stories.title: Doctors may now see the hidden signs of sudden cardiac death

MVP causes the valve to bend backward as the heart contracts, while MR affects the valve's ability to close fully, leading to blood leaking backward.

stories.title: George Church of Harvard to present at the 13th Aging Research & Drug Discovery (ARDD) meeting in Boston
stories.description:
ARDD 2026 has announced that George Church, Professor at Harvard Medical School, will speak at the 13th Aging Research & Drug Discovery (ARDD) Meeting, taking place October 1–3, 2026, at the David Rubenstein Treehouse at Harvard University. As the world's leading conference dedicated to longevity biotechnology, ARDD 2026 will convene top researchers, pharmaceutical executives, entrepreneurs, and investors to accelerate the translation of aging science into next-generation medicines.
Organized by Insilico Medicine and supported by industry leaders including Eli Lilly and the McKinsey Health Institute, the meeting reflects the growing momentum behind longevity as a major frontier in biomedical innovation. With speakers representing ten of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies, ARDD 2026 aims to foster the collaborations needed to transform discoveries in aging biology into therapies that extend healthy lifespan and improve patient outcomes.

stories.title: Circadian rhythms and sarcopenia: Unlocking the biological clock in muscle aging

Researchers propose circadian-aligned lifestyle interventions and pharmacological treatments as potential strategies to combat age-related muscle loss, offering new avenues for sarcopenia management in the elderly.
